title: What Freelance Playbook Is and Why It Matters
summary: The foundations of freelance playbook: what it is and why getting it right pays off.
body:
Freelancing trades a boss for clients: set your rate from real math, find work through network + platforms, and run it like a business (taxes, contracts, boundaries).

Why it matters: Rate formula: (salary goal + expenses + taxes) / billable hours Freelancers typically bill 50-60% of working hours

title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Freelance Playbook
summary: Start freelance playbook this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Define your service and ideal client
2. Set rate from the math, not fear
3. Build 3-5 portfolio pieces
4. Tell your network you're available
5. Land first 2-3 clients (warm beats cold)

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.

Set rate from the math, not fear

- Underpricing to 'get started' → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.

title: Freelance Playbook: Safety, Legal, and Fine Print
summary: What to watch out for with freelance playbook: safety, contracts, and fine print.
body:
Read before you act: No contract And: Underpricing to 'get started'

General rules: get agreements in writing, understand what you're signing, keep records of money in and out, and know when a professional (lawyer, accountant, vet, doctor — depending on the domain) is worth the fee. An hour of professional advice beats a month of fixing.
